decision: Does one seven-parameter scorer shared across all actions fix the flat model's measured action-relative and final-tie residual while retaining the frozen current-observation corpus and hard behavior target?

diagnostic_basis.selection_rationale: All current features reconstruct the collector exactly, but the flat 114--32--18 model duplicates action geometry across 18 outputs and agrees on only 74.9 percent of validation reactive actions, including 0.3 percent focused-stage and 3.9 percent lexical-stage agreement. Neither 500 more hard-target updates nor the paired full-propensity target met its frozen explanatory threshold.

fit.normalization: mean and population standard deviation over train legal action rows only; sub-1e-9 scales become 1
fit.validation_use: evaluate exactly once after the train-only stopping rule; never select a feature, update, threshold, scale, or optimizer

gate.absolute_distribution_fit: validation KL(recorded mu || candidate) must be no greater than 0.1 nat
gate.final_tie_target: pooled validation agreement on rows first decided by focused or lexical tie breaking must be at least 0.5
gate.optimization: after at least 100 updates, final train gradient L2 must be no more than 0.01 times its all-zero initial value
gate.proper_score: the upper endpoint of the 2000-draw whole-episode bootstrap 95 percent interval for candidate minus frozen-L1d validation cross-entropy to the exact recorded behavior distribution must be below zero
gate.reactive_target: validation argmax agreement with the recorded reactive action must be at least 0.95
gate.rationale: The proper-score interval requires generalization beyond L1d; KL <= 0.1 prevents a tiny relative gain from promoting a poor distribution; 0.95 overall and 0.5 pooled final-tie agreement directly test the diagnosed action-structure failure. These thresholds were fixed before fitting and are not tuned from validation.
gate.timebox: stop immediately when the train-only gradient criterion passes, or after 10000 full-batch updates; non-convergence is inconclusive

hypothesis: The dominant L1d residual is duplicated flat-output learning rather than missing observation. Sharing one scalar linear scorer across actions and explicitly deriving the already-defined boundary reserve will converge, improve held-out exact-distribution proper score over frozen L1d, reach validation KL at most 0.1 nat, reproduce at least 95 percent of reactive actions, and recover at least half of the rare focused/lexical final ties.

model_scope.derived_portable_facts: Each legal action row contains only observed clearance knownness/value, boundary reserve derived from its recorded final x/y, equality to current action, stationary/focused action attributes, and fixed lexical action-name rank.
model_scope.sharing: One weight vector scores every canonical action; the observed-shield mask remains external and cannot be widened.
model_scope.unchanged_target: Training remains one-hot published executed action cross-entropy so the sole learner change is the structured shared scorer. Exact recorded propensities are used only for audit and prospective proper-score evaluation.

non_goals: no new Wine collection, online execution, or corpus mutation
no baseline_action actor input, direct reactive-winner feature, stage, boss, spell, ECL, RNG, run identity, future fact, or counterexample-specific feature
no full-propensity training target, temperature, fixed 0.8 mixture output, or post-hoc calibration
no width, depth, feature, threshold, seed, optimizer, learning-rate, L2, or update-budget sweep
no history, recurrent model, object-set encoder, auxiliary target, IQL, reward change, or value learning
no HIT-reduction, gameplay-improvement, NMNB, or transfer claim

online_canary.scope_if_later_admitted: one separately preregistered complete natural-RNG original-Wine Lunatic Practice Stage 4 integration run; not training or policy-improvement evidence
